section2.label: Which digital tools do you currently rely on most for community engagement?

options.label: Spatial & GIS Platforms: Maptionnaire, Felt, ArcGIS, etc.
Visual Collaboration Boards: Miro, Mural, Figma, etc.
Standard Survey Tools: Typeform, Google Forms, SurveyMonkey, etc.
Social & Messaging Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Groups, etc.
Custom / Proprietary Software: In-house or specialized municipal platforms

section2.label: What are your biggest challenges in community engagement?

options.label: Demographic Reach: Reaching diverse age groups and bridging digital vs. physical participation
Data Structuring: Converting qualitative feedback (sticky notes, comments) into actionable GIS data
Visual Communication: Helping non-experts understand complex 2D/3D spatial plans
Conflict Resolution: Navigating opposing views between different stakeholder groups
Sustaining Momentum: Keeping residents engaged across long planning and approval timelines
Executive Buy-in: Creating clear, data-driven reports that convince city councils and decision-makers
Resource Limits: Lacking the budget or technical setup to launch custom engagement tools

section3.label: Which features would you test first in PLACER?

options.label: Real-time participatory mapping
Interactive 3D / AR spatial visualizations
Structured, topic-based discussion threads
Instant PDF summary reports for city councils
Community voting & project prioritization modules
Other

section3.label: How would you like to participate in co-creating PLACER?

options.label: Just by submitting this survey (No further commitment required)
Testing early prototypes and providing feedback
Joining a 15-minute interview to share specific workflow needs
Submitting a real project as a test case study
